card.name: Digits and commas in forum post timestamps
card.fires_on: Punctuation or digits inside the date and time stamp of a web comment or forum post, such as the comma after the year or a digit in the clock time. Also a post number after #.

modes.label: Comma after date
modes.description: The comma that follows the year in a comment date, just before the clock time.

modes.label: Digits in clock time
modes.description: A digit inside the hour or minute of a posted time.
